mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 55 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School, and we are currently seeing a waning gibbous moon.

The city reminds residents that winter street parking regulations, which help emergency vehicles and snow plows, begin November 20 and run until April 1, and please note the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.
We have plenty of community fun starting today with Main Street Trick-Or-Treat and live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow.
In the weekly recap, on October 25, officers responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at an intersection where a man was arrested for an O W I.
Today's featured flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry, and since the store is open, you should stop by before we close at 10:30 PM.
